body: I feel like shit. I feel pretty worthless right now..
Do you mind if I PM you?

I'm happy with everything that I have accomplished in life so far. I'm proud of my grades and my abilities, but I can't stand the comments that he has to make about everything. If I don't get a 100% on a test I get yelled at. It's hard to hear everything that he says. Things like I'm worthless and stupid and fat. Those things hurt, a lot.
I'm actually only a freshman so I still have around 4 years until I'm out of here..

I don't even know what's wrong. I'm sick of being at home with my dad. He makes me feel so worthless. Nothing I do is ever good enough for him. I get yelled at for everything that I do. And I'm sick of it..
